### Featured build

#### 🛡️ [ID-SHIELD / CaseVault — Explainable Multi-Document Forensics Platform](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/case-vault)

<a href="https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/case-vault"><img src="./assets/casevault-forensics.svg?v=v2" width="100%" alt="ID-SHIELD Forensics: Multi-Document Evidence Fusion and Cryptographic Audit Logs"></a>

**What if identity fraud isn't an obviously fake document, but a set of individually plausible documents that contradict each other?**

In our **Smart India Hackathon 2026** build (Team HackHive · SIH26188), manual inspection failed repeatedly when presented with individually legitimate documents that harbored subtle cross-record conflicts: altered birth years between passport and driving license, manipulated photo regions, or conflicting residential addresses across multiple states.

I architected **ID-SHIELD** around multi-document **evidence fusion**:

- **Cross-Record Contradiction Engine:** Rather than isolated OCR verification, the system builds an interconnected discrepancy graph across all submitted credentials, immediately flagging semantic contradictions.
- **Tamper-Evident Merkle Audit Trail:** Every verification step, OCR extraction result, and examiner review is cryptographically hashed with SHA-256 into an immutable block sequence to ensure non-repudiation.
- **Zero-Trust Access Control:** Enforces strict role-based access control (RBAC) with field-level encryption for sensitive personally identifiable information (PII).

[Explore ID-SHIELD Repository ↗](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/case-vault) · [Read Forensics Architecture Docs ↗](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/case-vault#readme)

### Core systems & security lab

<img src="./assets/project-reel.svg?v=v2" width="100%" alt="Visual Systems Reel: TarkAI AST Security Auditor and Adaptive Traffic Signal Preemption">

#### 🛡️ [TarkAI (तर्क) — Local-First Intelligent Code Auditor & AST Security Mentor](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/tark-ai)

A local-first engineering evaluation and static application security testing (SAST) engine combining Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) static analysis, Halstead software metrics, subprocess execution, Leitner spaced repetition, and tiered Socratic mentoring.

- **Inside TarkAI:** Rather than running untrusted code directly, TarkAI traverses the Python 3.12 AST to detect dangerous anti-patterns, command injection vectors, and unsafe subprocess invocations *before* execution. Halstead metrics compute vocabulary and effort scores to identify security and algorithmic bottlenecks.
- **Engineering Studio:** Implements a dark obsidian glass interface with 33 passing automated unit test suites.

[Inspect TarkAI ↗](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/tark-ai)

#### 🚦 [Adaptive Traffic Signals — OpenCV Queue Optimization & Emergency Vehicle Priority](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/ai-traffic-signal-optimization)

An intelligent real-time computer vision controller that replaces rigid, static timers with dynamic demand-based signal scheduling and automated emergency vehicle preemption.

- **Inside the Traffic Engine:** Mohammed Jawwad and I engineered an OpenCV simulation that computes real-time vehicle density using MOG2 background subtraction and morphological filtering. Green phase timings dynamically scale between **8 and 35 seconds** based on actual queue pressure.
- **Emergency Vehicle (EV) Preemption:** Implements an automated priority override state machine that detects approaching emergency strobes/sirens, forces an immediate yellow clearance cycle, and grants an uninterrupted green wave.

[Explore the Project ↗](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/ai-traffic-signal-optimization) · [Read the Signal Logic ↗](https://github.com/ZephyrusZorro/ai-traffic-signal-optimization/blob/main/traffic_logic.py)

### `cat field-notes/forensic-integrity`

<img src="./assets/session.svg?v=v2" width="100%" alt="ID-SHIELD Forensics Vault: Verified Session Replay">

When designing security software for adversarial environments, the biggest mistake is treating individual verification checks as binary truth. A counterfeit credential will often pass a localized OCR or font check with flying colors. True anomaly detection occurs when you cross-reference multiple independent credentials against each other and calculate graph-level inconsistency scores.

Furthermore, software should never act as an opaque verdict machine. In ID-SHIELD, we pair confidence scoring with visual bounding-box citations and commit each human certifier's action into a SHA-256 Merkle audit trail. The audit log guarantees that the chain of custody remains tamper-evident long after the verification session ends.

### Cybersecurity trajectory & competencies

I am actively immersing myself in cybersecurity with the ambition to excel as a **Security Engineer & Systems Hardener**. My core areas of practice include:

- **Application Security (AppSec) & SAST:** Parsing Abstract Syntax Trees to detect injection vectors, dangerous system calls, prototype pollution, and security anti-patterns in CI/CD pipelines.
- **Digital Forensics & Evidence Integrity:** Designing tamper-evident audit logs with Merkle trees, EXIF metadata manipulation detection, and cryptographic access control.
- **Offensive Security & Vulnerability Research:** Exploring ethical hacking, penetration testing methodology, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (SQLi, SSRF, IDOR, broken auth), and network traffic analysis with Wireshark and Nmap.
- **Defensive Engineering & Zero Trust:** Designing local-first, privacy-by-default software architectures with least-privilege RBAC, encrypted persistent storage, and secure offline-first fallbacks.

### A few things I've learned

**1. Fraud and vulnerabilities hide in the seams between systems, not inside a single document.**
A forged document can easily pass a standalone OCR check. True resilience comes from correlating multi-record evidence sets and mapping discrepancy graphs across data boundaries.

**2. Static analysis is dramatically faster and safer than runtime sandboxing.**
In TarkAI, inspecting the AST before execution catches unsafe subprocess calls and security anti-patterns in milliseconds without exposing the host environment to arbitrary code execution risks.

**3. Always architect for the disconnected edge.**
In LabLens, designing an automatic failover from cloud APIs to local Ollama models turned a fragile prototype into a rock-solid bench assistant that continues working even when network infrastructure collapses.
